styles.name: periodic-table
styles.description: Periodic table: the real 18-group silhouette with its f-block strip; elements light up in atomic-number order

styles.name: electron-orbitals
styles.description: Electron orbitals: s-sphere, p-dumbbell and d-cloverleaf clouds fill with shimmering electrons in turn

styles.name: titration-curve
styles.description: Titration: a sigmoid pH–volume curve draws out while drips fall and the equivalence point appears

styles.name: reaction-kinetics
styles.description: Reaction kinetics: [A] decays exponentially while [B] rises to equilibrium — both curves fill

styles.name: crystallization
styles.description: Crystallization: a two-ion checkerboard lattice grows from a central seed with faceted edges while free ions drift in solution

styles.name: ph-scale
styles.description: pH scale: a marker slides left (acid) to right (base) along a shaded gradient track

styles.name: gas-diffusion
styles.description: Gas diffusion: molecules spread from a point source — cloud density is a Gaussian growing with progress

styles.name: distillation
styles.description: Distillation: a boiling flask feeds vapour down a condenser; distillate drips into an Erlenmeyer receiver that fills

styles.name: bond-vibration
styles.description: Bond vibration: two atoms on a coiled-spring bond vibrate; the bond stretches across the bar with progress

styles.name: boltzmann-distribution
styles.description: Maxwell-Boltzmann: velocity histogram builds up — temperature rises with progress, broadening the peak

styles.name: flame-spectral-lines
styles.description: Flame test: discrete emission lines flicker into existence as progress reveals each spectral line
